description.value: Trek Bicycle Burnaby is a full-service Trek and Bontrager brand shop on Kingsway in Burnaby, offering sales, parts, clothing, and professional repair on bikes of any brand or make. The shop is a reliable stop for touring cyclists thanks to its walk-in, no-appointment repair model and fast 24-hour service turnaround — with a complimentary demo bike provided if that window is missed. Additional perks include free multi-point inspections, free accessory installation, and local ride recommendations from staff.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 9m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 58m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and rich, confirming the OSM record with minor discrepancies: OSM lists the name as 'Trek' while the website consistently uses 'Trek Bicycle Burnaby', and the website provides a fuller address with postal code. The service page explicitly states '24-hour service turnaround on bikes of any brand, including all e-bikes. No appointment needed,' confirming walk-in repair capability, same-day/next-day urgent repairs, e-bike service, and staff ability to handle mechanicals. No evidence was found in the website content for pump access, DIY stand, washrooms, water refill, device charging, e-bike charging, rentals, bike boxes, or touring-specific parts.
concerns: OSM name field is 'Trek' but the website consistently identifies this location as 'Trek Bicycle Burnaby'; name updated to website value per rule 12.
OSM address lacks unit number and postal code; website provides fuller address '101-5400 Kingsway, Burnaby, BC V5H 2E9' which has been used.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service bicycle shop with walk-in no-appointment repairs, 24-hour turnaround, and explicit e-bike service — directly useful to touring cyclists needing urgent mechanical support in the Vancouver/Burnaby area.

Staff help with urgent mechanical issues.detail: We know being without your bike is the worst. That's why we offer fast, 24-hour turnaround on most service jobs. We service all makes & models.

Walk-in repairs.detail: No appointment needed. Stop by one of our bike service centers today, and our expert in-store technicians will have your ride rolling like new in no time at all.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: Website: '24-hour turnaround on most service jobs'; if turnaround exceeds 24 hours, a complimentary demo bike is provided. Customer review corroborates: bike returned in under 24 hours

E-bike service.detail: Service page: 'We offer 24-hour service turnaround on bikes of any brand, including all e-bikes.'

wow_evidence: 24-hour service turnaround on bikes of any brand, including all e-bikes. No appointment needed
